articles.title: Ouch! Bear Cub Gets a Paw Full of Porcupine Quills
articles.summary: A curious bear cub in Alaska got too close to a porcupine and ended up with a paw full of sharp quills. The cub, named 901jr, was seen on a live bear cam. The quills should fall out on their own.

articles.title: This Tiny Creature Turns into a Hulk and Eats Its Family!
articles.summary: A tiny single-celled creature called Euplotes gigatrox can grow into a giant that eats its smaller siblings. Scientists found it in an aquarium filter. The change happens when there's lots of food, but no one knows exactly why.

articles.title: Sheep's Wool Could Help Fix Broken Bones!
articles.summary: Scientists found that a material made from sheep's wool can help regrow bone. They tested it on rats with skull injuries. The new bone was stronger and more like natural bone than what the current best material makes.
